system.name: GPCPR (Generated and Pseudo Content guided Prototype Refinement)
system.one_liner: Few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation that refines class prototypes with LLM-generated class descriptions and pseudo-query context, plus dual distillation.

content.variant_note: one prototype line crosses three dashed panels (generate, refine with LLM text, refine with pseudo-query context); red dashed distillation arrows run over the top and along the bottom
content.argues: Prototypes from the support set alone are weak; adding LLM-generated class text and reliable pseudo-query context, tied together by prototype and logit distillation, refines them before the query is segmented.
content.subject: support and query point clouds flowing through an encoder, text-driven and pseudo-query-driven prototype refinement, distillation links and the final prediction

new_tags.name: prototype-capsule
new_tags.what: a vertical capsule holding one distinct glyph per class, redrawn after every stage to show the same set being refined

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw the object being refined as one recurring glyph (here a capsule of ring, square, triangle) and redraw it after every stage; attach distillation or loss links to those copies with a distinct arrow colour, so the stage effects and the regularisers can be read at once.
lessons.suits: multi-stage refinement of one representation (prototypes, queries, memories) with auxiliary losses between stages and several frozen or trainable modules.

evidence: we utilize a shared point encoder to extract per point query and support features
Dual-distillation, i.e., prototype distillation and logit distillation, further enhance the refinement process.
The query flow measures distances between query point features and refined prototypes to predict segmentation results.

summary: GPCPR is a few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation framework that refines class prototypes with LLM-generated class descriptions and with pseudo-query context. The figure is a left-to-right network diagram in three dashed panels. In (a) a shared Point Encoder turns support and query scans into features and vanilla prototypes. In (b) two text-to-prototype compressors, fed by text encoder and adapter chains over LLM descriptions of class names, refine them. In (c) QGPA and a Query-to-Proto compressor, driven by a pseudo prediction, refine them again before the final prediction. Red dashed arrows tie early and deeper prototypes, and pseudo and final logits, to distillation boxes; a corner key explains the flame, snowflake, dot-product and cosine-similarity glyphs.
summary_zh: GPCPR 用 LLM 生成的类别描述和伪查询上下文精炼小样本点云分割的原型。图分三个虚线面板自左向右展开：原型生成、文本引导精炼、伪查询引导精炼，红色虚线连到两个蒸馏框，左下角图例说明可训练、冻结和算子符号。
